source.title: Bhote Koshi 2026 ice–rock avalanche: NISAR L2 GOFF site series and footprint-wide offset-tracking screen — data and code
source.author: Sansar Raj Meena
source.caveat: The separately licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 mapped runout extent is not included in this ZIP and has not been copied into this repository.

manifest_audit.interpretation: README.md was supplied separately, the six CC BY-NC extent components are separate record components, and MANIFEST.json does not hash itself.

site_field_geotiff_profile.source: Raster profiles inspected from all five fields/*.tif

readme_profile_mismatch.observed_geotiffs: EPSG:4326, 73x80, three bands (dE, dN, R); magnitude is derivable from dE/dN but is not stored as a band
readme_profile_mismatch.classification: Documentation inconsistency to preserve and report, not silently normalize.

author_method_facts.site_series_geometry: make_pot_figure.py selects the nearest radarGrid XY sample at the declared crown coordinate and uses the median along the geometry height axis for each scalar geometry component. This differs from the current branch's per-pixel geometry sampled at a fixed configured height.
author_method_facts.quality_gates: finite SNR, SNR >= 5, and projected horizontal magnitude <= 10 m. The site-series source does not use correlationSurfacePeak as an input-validity gate.
author_method_facts.reference: component-wise median dE/dN in the WIDE box outside the rectangular AOI mask; the mask is built from transformed mid-row/mid-column coordinate axes.
author_method_facts.coherence: 5x5 mean resultant length via scipy.ndimage.uniform_filter defaults (reflect edges), normalized by finite-vector count, retained only where finite support fraction > 0.5 (at least 13 of 25). Site-series P1 crown R is computed after cropping to the crown slice; P1 background R is computed on the full WIDE box. Polygon-null R is a separate estimator.
author_method_facts.polygon_null: seed 20260907; 1200 unique candidate centres sampled without replacement from all finite-R cells; circular radius sqrt(npx/pi); accept >=60% of target valid cells; crown percentile counts strict draws < crown, resolved-against-box fraction counts strict draws > box.
author_method_facts.missing_script: The deposit plan lists displacement_null.py, but this script is absent; tables/displacement_null.json and summaries are present.
author_method_facts.scripts_portability: make_pot_figure.py contains a workstation-specific I:\nisar\nepal_bhotekoshi_t098 root; no environment lock/requirements file is included.

branch_method_mismatches: Current analysis samples geometry per pixel at configured height, unlike site-series crown-local median geometry.
Current analysis requires finite correlation as input_valid; author site-series gate does not use correlationSurfacePeak.
Current coherence kernel zero-pads edges and defaults to minimum_valid_cells=1; author site-series uses reflected edges and finite-window fraction >0.5.
Current projected polygon-centre masks do not match author transformed-axis rectangle mask/crown_slice; historical raw replay had 296 valid crown cells versus 298 published for 26 Jul–19 Aug.
Current controls choose centres outside crown and exclude crown from control masks; author polygon_null samples unique centres from all finite-R cells and disks can overlap the crown.

Author P1 crown R is computed after cropping to crown; current generic summary computes neighbourhood field before selecting crown centres, closer to the separate polygon-null estimate. P1, P2 and polygon-null columns are distinct estimands.

field_raster_verification.source_method: Archived author coherence: unit vectors, scipy.ndimage.uniform_filter default reflect edges, normalize by finite support, retain support fraction > 0.5.
field_raster_verification.comparison_method: Recomputed R from bands 1 and 2 of each uploaded site-field GeoTIFF and compared with band 3 on common finite cells. Read float32 bands were promoted to float64 for calculations; output is then compared with archived float32 R.
field_raster_verification.interpretation: Validates the archived derived R band against archived dE/dN in the same exported WGS84 rasters. It is not a source-HDF5 replay and does not validate the crown mask or full-footprint products.

exported_field_crown_mask_diagnostic.diagnostic_input: Apply the author's crown_slice to each 80x73 exported WGS84 field array using the GeoTIFF bounds as extent endpoints. This diagnoses the exported grids only; it is not the original GOFF source-grid crop.

displacement_valid_crown_cells.definition: Count finite dE and dN pairs (equivalently finite horizontal magnitude) within the author crown slice. This is a displacement-support count, not a coherence-window count.

R_valid_crown_cells.definition: Compute the author's 5x5 coherence map across the full exported dE/dN field using scipy.ndimage.uniform_filter default reflected edges, finite-vector normalization, and finite-support fraction >0.5; then count finite R cells within the author crown slice. This is the polygon-null R support count, not P1 crown R (which computes coherence after cropping).

R_band_crosscheck.method: Recomputed full-grid R from each exported dE/dN pair using the author coherence kernel and compared it with archived band 3 on common finite cells.

exported_field_crown_mask_diagnostic.interpretation: The prior audit incorrectly compared displacement-valid crown counts with polygon-null R-valid n_px counts. Once the estimands are matched, both count series agree across all five exported fields. Aggregate counts on the exported WGS84 fields do not prove pixelwise parity against the original GOFF source grid.
exported_field_crown_mask_diagnostic.remaining_uncertainty: The original GOFF coordinate vectors, exact source read window and author pre-export masks/rasterization extents are not present in the archive. The reason for any source-grid pixel-mask difference is unresolved and no cause is inferred.
exported_field_crown_mask_diagnostic.required_evidence_to_resolve: Exact author P05023 raw GOFF source bytes and SHA-256, original grid-coordinate vectors and source read window, plus author pre-export masks/rasterization extents or enough source code/data to reconstruct and compare them.
